technical.summary: GD shows bullish momentum with strong moving average alignment and MACD crossover, but overbought stochastic conditions and weak ADX trend strength limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: GD shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 85 days present timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear zone (38 VIX equivalent) with bearish AAII sentiment (53%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (106+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (317.4) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 85 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with MACD crossover up and StochRSI cross-up provide technical momentum entry signals in a fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis regime (317.4), overbought stochastic conditions (92.11), weak ADX trend strength (14.21), zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 85 days create excessive downside risk that outweighs technical signals.
